text:
Product Overview
The PM3010FSNR V2 has 8*10/100Mbps adaptive RJ45 ports and 2*10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 ports. Each RJ45 port supports MDI/MDIX auto-flip and wire-speed forwarding function. Ports 1-8 have PoE power supply function, supports IEEE 802.3af/at standard, supports up to 800m long-distance transmission (used with long-distance equipment), and can be used as Power over Ethernet device, which can automatically detect and identify the powered devices that meet the standard and supply power to them through the network cable. Uses store-and-forward technology, combined with dynamic memory allocation, to ensure that bandwidth is efficiently allocated to each port.
The PM3010FSNR V2 provides one-click VLAN and CCTV functions. Users can enable or disable the CCTV functions according to different application environments to improve network security and suppress network storms. The PM3010FSNR V2 is easy to manage and maintain, and meets the networking and access requirements of enterprises, communities, hotels, office networks, and campus networks.
Features
Support IEEE802.3at/af standard;
Single port output power up to 30W;
100Mbps data transmission and PoE power supply distance up to 300m(Typical);
10Mbps data transmission and PoE power supply distance up to 800m;
Automatic detection and identification of standard PoE powered devices, intelligent power supply, will not burn non-standard PoE powered devices or ordinary devices;
Supports IEEE802.3x full-duplex flow control and Backpressure half-duplex flow control;
Panel indicators monitor operating status and help with fault analysis;
Wire-speed forwarding, intelligent recognition;
Data exchange using store-and-forward method;
Support PD-ALIVE function;
Support CCTV and VLAN toggle switch online switching;
Motherboard, Power Supply, PoE (3 in 1).
Product Specifications
Model	PM3010FSNR V2
Interface	8*10/100Mbps RJ45 ports / 2*10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 ports
Network Media	10BASE-T： UTP category 3,4,5 cable （≤100m） / 100BASE-TX：UTP category 5, 5e cable （≤100m）
Standard	IEEE802.3,IEEE802.3u,IEEE802.3i,IEEE802.3ab,IEEE802.3x,IEEE802.3af,IEEE802.3at
Key Function	CCTV&VLAN
Indicator	PWR、LNK/ACT、PoE
MAC Address Table	8K，Auto-learning, Auto-aging
Jumbo Frame	9K Byte
Packet Buffer	4Mbit
Transfer Mode	store-and-forward
Bandwidth	5.6Gbps
Packet Forwarding Rate	4.17Mpps
PoE Port	1~8 port
PoE Output-Port	Max 30W
RJ45 PoE Power Supply	1/2(+),3/6(-),4/5(+),7/8(-)
PoE Total	120W
Power Supply	130W
Mains Input	100~240V AC， 50/60Hz
Operating Temperature	0°C ~ 40 °C
Storage Temperature	-40 °C ~ 70 °C
Operating Humidity	10% ~ 90% RH  non-condensing
Storage Humidity	5% ~ 90% RH  non-condensing
Device Dimension	220*150*44mm
Machine Weight	>1kg
Surge Protection	Differential mode ±2KV, Common mode ±4KV,
MTBF	>50000 hours
Electrostatic Standard	Contact ±6KV , Air ±8KV
